title: Occasional errors saying "The access point /org/freedesktop/NetworkManager/AccessPoint/542 was not in the scan list"
line: Connecting to a new Wi-Fi network no longer fails with "not in the scan list" when the network was rescanned while you typed the password.
explanation: While the inline password field is open, the Networks widget holds back model updates, so the item keeps the access point path it had when Connect was clicked. If NetworkManager rescans meanwhile (for example after resume) and the same network comes back under a new access point object, the handler asked libnm-qt for the dead path, which recreated an empty access point, and NetworkManager rejected the request as not in the scan list (the notification even had an empty network name). The applet now passes the SSID as well, and the handler only uses the given path if the device still lists it, otherwise it uses the device's current access point for that SSID.

commits.message:
applet: find the access point again if a scan replaced it

A scan while the password was being typed could replace the access
point, so the applet sent its old path and NetworkManager refused it as
not in the scan list. Now it also passes the SSID to find the new one.

BUG: 495706

media.caption: Password typed after a rescan replaced the access point: "Failed to add" with the old AccessPoint/ap4 path
Same steps with the fix: no error, NetworkManager gets the current AccessPoint/ap5
